obligations.name: admin_message_reaction
obligations.description: Identify the reaction (and its emoji) attached to a message authored by a user holding the admin role in the workspace, via reaction → message → author → workspace membership; the intended admin is not disambiguated by the prompt, yielding two possible target reactions.
obligations.scope: reactions on messages authored by a workspace admin

task_spec.text: Look up which emoji reaction landed on the message posted by our workspace admin and report it.
